## Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to design a privacy-first, real-time NLP system operating across tenants and languages, with strict data isolation, auditable traces, and integration with Snowflake. Emphasizes latency, robustness to obfuscation, and operations like drift testing and rollback.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time multilingual detection
- Privacy-preserving logging (DP)
- Per-tenant isolation in data stores
- Redaction in streaming path
- Production evaluation (offline metrics, live A/B, rollback)

## Code Example
```python
import re
def redact(text):
  text = re.sub(r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b', '[PII]', text)
  text = re.sub(r'(AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}', '[SECRET]', text)
  return text
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This tests building a robust, privacy-preserving NLP system for compliance across languages with explainability and governance.

## Key Concepts
- Multilingual transformers, redaction, audit logging, drift detection
- On-device processing, per-message explanations, rollout strategy

## Code Example
```python
import re
PII_REGEX = re.compile(r'\b(?:\w+@\w+|\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\b')
def redact(text):
    return PII_REGEX.sub('[REDACTED]', text)
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you evaluate explainability at scale for compliance reviewers?
- How would you handle language drift in 24/7 chat streams?
